description: cmix v21 forced text-mode wrapper using the mmap allocator plus PAQ8 level 6 instead of level 11. The binary and english.dic are gzip-compressed and counted toward program_size.
hypothesis: PAQ8 level 7 still crossed the 10 GiB ceiling at 250K. PAQ8 level 6 should provide enough headroom to finish the 250K gate; archive quality determines whether the cmix21 text branch remains competitive.
deps: C++ runtime for the vendored cmix binary
POSIX mmap and temporary filesystem space
verdict: Unmeasured. This is the next candidate after PAQ7 failed 250K memory.
